verdict.rationale: PayPal documents real, registrable outbound webhooks: HTTPS posts to up to 10 subscribed URLs per app, scoped to chosen event types, with retries for up to 3 days and a signature-verification endpoint. The REST overview, which anchors the agent surface, also references a Webhook events catalog. However, the pack never names the order lifecycle event types the story asks for (created, updated, fulfilled, canceled), and it does not tie webhooks to agentic cart or checkout flows, where Store Sync instead hands orders to the merchant's own order management system. Missing for 10: documented order created/updated/fulfilled/canceled event types, webhook coverage of agentic cart/checkout sessions, hands-on or independent corroboration.
